tier5_assessment: Tier 5 (queries 18-22) surfaced no item a name-search query missed this run. EMA has not yet published November 2026 CHMP meeting highlights; MHLW/PMDA has not published a November batch-approval release; MFDS's monthly roundup is published only after month-end (November is not yet over); the FDA's own Novel-Drug-Approvals page could not be retrieved with row-level content via search this run (a direct-fetch limitation, not a finding); NMPA's most recent confirmed late-October approvals (batoclimab, asundexian) are off the Tier-5 molecule list. This is a clean, non-wasted sweep in the same sense as 2026-11-16: it positively rules out a same-day regulatory surprise this cycle, though the FDA-page retrieval gap this run (content not returned by search) is a minor methodological weakness worth a direct WebFetch attempt in a future run if search snippets keep coming back header-only.

fetch_failures_non_block.resolution: Could not reach the article directly. Relied instead on the article's own URL-date convention (YYYYMMDD path segment, matching the pattern already validated for this outlet elsewhere in the tracker) and on the search tool independently returning the same quoted Korean sentence describing the 25-gauge-needle nonclinical result across three separately-worded queries, as corroboration that the content and date are genuine. No second independent outlet carrying the same specific 25-gauge/PK detail was found despite three targeted follow-up searches (direct quote search, English-language search, and a search naming alternate outlets by name) -- logged at Secondary rather than Primary confidence as a result, per Gate C's downgrade-rather-than-inherit rule.
